# mammoth-cli

> Command-line interface for the Mammoth Analytics platform, built for autonomous agents: deterministic JSON output, promptless mode, and stable error envelopes.

## Guides

- [installation.md](docs/installation.md): Install the CLI and the agent skill.
- [quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): Authenticate and run your first commands in five minutes.
- [authentication.md](docs/authentication.md): Credentials, profiles, server prefixes, and project context.
- [agents.md](docs/agents.md): Deterministic output, promptless mode, and CI patterns for agents.
- [safety.md](docs/safety.md): Confirmation policies and safe mutation.
- [troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): Exit codes, error envelopes, and recovery.
- [upgrade.md](docs/upgrade.md): Update the CLI and skill.
- [uninstall.md](docs/uninstall.md): Remove the CLI, skill, and configuration.
- [command reference](docs/reference/commands.md): every command.
- [agent skill](mammoth_cli/bundled_skill/mammoth-cli/SKILL.md): the installable skill.
